# RM brief — FIFTY-FIFTH FILMS LIMITED (11949076)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by CON-04 — Micro-entity accounts  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- Fifty-Fifth Films Limited (company number 11949076) is an active private limited company incorporated on 16 April 2019, roughly 7.5 years old, operating under SIC code 59112. It has five active officers, all of whom have served since first appointment, with no new appointments in the last 12 months. `[profile; officers; computed]`
- The company has no charges registered at any time, so its security position is clean and a first-charge facility could in principle be offered subject to the remaining policies. `[SEC-02]`
- Filing conduct is consistently strong: all six accounts filings since 2020 were submitted ahead of deadline, ranging from 15 to 97 days early, and the most recent accounts (made up to 30 April 2025) were filed on 12 January 2026, 16 days early. Nothing is overdue and the next accounts are not due until 31 January 2027. `[AA filed 2026-01-12; AA filed 2025-01-13; AA filed 2023-10-23; AA filed 2022-12-12; AA filed 2022-01-05; AA filed 2020-12-29; profile]`
- Every set of accounts filed has been on the micro-entity basis, which under CON-04 does not disclose turnover or profit and is insufficient on its own to assess serviceability. This drives the REFER outcome. `[CON-04; profile]`
- Before any decision can be taken, management accounts covering the most recent 12 months must be obtained from the company. `[CON-04]`
- Note also that the latest accounts are made up to 30 April 2025, some 17 months before the review date of 30 September 2026, so the filed figures are dated and management information will be needed to bridge the gap. `[computed; profile]`
